system.longDesc: You can psychically sense others’ feelings and influence them to some degree.
system.requirement: Power talent: Willpower (Empathy) power focus at Expert

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Empathy effect. You also gain the power focus Willpower (Empathy).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Empathy effect. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Empathy effects for –1 SP.
